neighbours.label: the copula (' is' / ' are' / ' is that') after a subject that announces an instance: 'An example of X is …', 'The contrary is that …'
fire: Some materials expand when heated. An example of this is the mercury in a thermometer.
Many plants store water. A common example of this is the cactus.
Animals often cooperate. An example of teamwork is wolves hunting in packs.
Not every tax is paid directly. An example of an indirect tax is the duty on fuel.
Energy can change form. An example of this is a battery powering a lamp.
People say cold weather causes colds. The contrary is that viruses spread indoors.
Some sounds are too high to hear. Examples of this are bat calls and dog whistles.
Cities limit noise at night. A very common example of such rules is a ban on late concerts.
quiet: Some materials expand when heated. The mercury in a thermometer is one of them.
Many plants store water. The cactus keeps it in a thick stem.
Animals often cooperate. Wolves, for example, hunt in packs.
Not every tax is paid directly. The duty on fuel is hidden in the price.
Energy can change form. A battery is able to power a lamp.
People say cold weather causes colds. Viruses, however, spread indoors.
Some sounds are too high to hear. Bat calls and dog whistles are like that.
Cities limit noise at night. A ban on late concerts is common.

notes: Card: ' is' x15, ' are' x7 after 'An example (of …)', 'Examples', 'The contrary'. Probes: 'An example of this is' 0.71, 'The contrary is that' 0.47, 'A very common example of zoning is' 0.31, 'One example of … is' 0.29, 'A common example is' 0.24, 'Examples are' 0.03-0.22; plain copulas 0.00-0.04, 'For example,' 0.02.
